component.title: AsyncOptionsField
component.purpose: A searchable asynchronous choice surface that keeps loading, failure, retry, and selection understandable.

states.description: A selected workspace with contextual descriptions.
A controlled choice remains visible and changeable.
A failed request provides an explicit retry path.

claims.statement: The field exposes combobox and listbox semantics with arrow-key navigation, selection, and escape-to-close behavior.
Cancellation, retry, empty, and offline states are represented as deliberate user-facing surfaces rather than silent failures.
The field and option descriptions remain readable without horizontal overflow on narrow viewports.
